MEET THE ARTIST / 카더가든

Car, the garden

Car, the garden is the singer-songwriter formerly known as Mayson the Soul. His music draws on rock, pop and R&B; his stage name is a playful translation of his Korean name, Cha Jung-won.

BALLAD / 2019

Tree나무

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Tree” was released as a single in April 2019. This performance aired on The Seasons — Choi Jung-hoon’s Night Park on June 16, 2023. KBS Kpop’s recording brings the song to a live television stage.
